title: High hat and tails: minstrels, the crash and Prohibition
summary: Green explains how minstrels popularised top hat and tails, which Harlem blacks wore only on special occasions until the end of Prohibition and nightlife made them fashionable.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Was it unusual for blacks to be wearing those clothes?

Well, in a way they were, because the blackface -- the minstrels had popularized the high hat and tails, because they was all considered doctors, you see. Remember minstrel shows, they had these -- they called themselves medicine shows, and they -- with the minstrels, you see. And they -- I think they introduced the high hat and tails to the public, so far as being in shows or on stage or in
entertainment. See? Otherwise, a man -- it was considered in every day wear, you see, but the very rich, they wore them kind of clothes, in different parts of the day.
But it wasn't -- for the black community it wasn't common to see people in high hat and tails, was it?
Only on special occasions like great holidays or something, parties, birthday parties and marriages and so forth, like that.
Well, were the Hotshots the first group, black group, to wear high hats and tails, or were there other groups prior to that?

Oh, there were plentiful prior to them. But it was outstanding on them, you see, because the blacking of the face, what they called the blackface comedians, they had went out of fashion, see, as they come along.

Well, it was early in -- I'm saying right after -- it was right after -- I think this was during -- after the Depression, you see. What they called after the '29 crash, right, the stock market crash in 1929, right? And after that I think our President made some -- spoke to the nation about how to overcome the Depression, not to let the Depression get the better of them and stop jumping out of windows and committing suicide, because they was going to

introduce Prohibition. Things became plentiful then when they introduced, bringing in the Prohibition, you see. They was going to legalize liquors and things, you see. And that made the high hat and tails very famous too, because people used to go out, you know, after the daytime, at night you know, where they could get a little kissey, see? And that's how they would dress. They would wear these high hat and tails, you know, and wherever they go.
Was this particularly up in Harlem that you're referring to, where people would go out?
